commands.review_summary:
The branch changes bounded web_fetch, provider error, HTTP error body, and generic HTTP snippet readers/tests to decode truncated byte prefixes without flushing incomplete UTF-8 sequences.

PR surface: Source +7, Tests +65. Total +72 across 8 files.

Reproducibility: yes. at source level: current plain-decode and final-flush paths render U+FFFD for an incomplete UTF-8 prefix, and the Node probe showed streaming-only decode drops it cleanly. I did not run a full OpenClaw provider or web_fetch scenario.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] The branch needs contributor-supplied real behavior proof and one PR-level sibling-reader fix before ordinary maintainer review can clear it.

target.title: fix(infra): drop replacement characters when response snippets truncate UTF-8
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users could see replacement characters in bounded web/provider error snippets when a response body was truncated in the middle of a multi-byte UTF-8 character.

## Why This Change Was Made

The bounded response readers now use streaming decode only for truncated byte prefixes, so incomplete trailing UTF-8 sequences are omitted instead of rendered as U+FFFD. The change keeps the normal full-response decode path flushing normally, uses fresh UTF-8 fallback decoders so fallback cannot retain streaming state between responses, and applies the same byte-prefix invariant across web, provider, and generic HTTP snippet readers.

## User Impact

Provider error details, generic HTTP snippets, and web_fetch snippets remain clean and readable when OpenClaw caps large response bodies at a byte boundary.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: bounded response text helpers drop partial UTF-8 characters when stream reads stop at maxBytes, while preserving clean fallback charset decoding between responses.
- Current-head proof at 6107c8bee281054d606fb585aa53ea67f4124cc4: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/http-error-body.test.ts src/agents/tools/web-shared.test.ts src/agents/provider-http-errors.test.ts src/infra/http-body.response.test.ts` passed 3 Vitest shards / 63 tests.
- PR diff hygiene: `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` passed.
- Review proof: `python .agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode branch --base upstream/main` passed with no accepted/actionable findings.
- Duplicate search: no open or closed OpenClaw PRs found for the bounded response UTF-8 truncation / replacement-character issue.
